Question Choices: A rectangle is partitioned into 3 rows and 6 columns. How many total same-sized squares are there?
Solution: There are 3 rows with 6 squares in each row. Add 6+6+6 = 18 squares.

Question Choices: Select which rectangle has MORE total same-sized squares. Rectangle A is divided into 3 rows and 5 columns of same-sized squares. Rectangle B is divided into 4 rows and 4 columns of same-sized squares. Which rectangle has MORE?: ~~A | B~~
Solution: A has 3 rows of 5: 5+5+5 = 15 squares. B has 4 rows of 4: 4+4+4+4 = 16 squares. Since 16 is greater than 15, select B.
